statements.status_notes: The dev images ship setuptools 79.0.1 for colcon, and this wheel 0.45.1 is the copy setuptools 79.0.1 vendors. The fix is in wheel 0.46.2, and setuptools vendors a fixed wheel from 80.10.2, a major upgrade the dev images cannot take yet: colcon-core 0.21.3 requires setuptools<80, and colcon build --symlink-install fails with setuptools 84 on the Debian images' colcon-core 0.19.0.
